name: Brian Clough
scopeNote: Two counted spells: Derby County (May 1967 to October 1973, Second Division 1968/69, First Division 1971/72, European Cup semi-final 1972/73) and Nottingham Forest (6 January 1975 to May 1993: First Division 1977/78, European Cups 1979 and 1980, League Cups). Exact day not found in a read page for the Derby start/end (Sky: 'joined Derby in May 1967', 'resigned in October 1973'), nor for the Forest end ('relegation in 1993'); partial dates used. The Forest start of 6 January 1975 is from a search summary of the EFL page (unreadable), so profilePeriod uses '1975-01' in the spell record. Style label: sources do not name a system; Clough himself rejected the word 'tactics' and spoke of 'philosophy' (Wilson: 'tactics by another name'): simple passing football 'on the floor', fixed player roles, fitness of personnel over formations, and psychology. Evidence for marking, pressing, transitions is thin: no page read states zonal or man-marking. Popular label 'no tactics' is the manager's own pose and Viv Anderson's recollection, contradicted by Wilson, and by the 1980 five-man midfield. Partial dates (1967-05, 1973-10, 1993-05, and the excluded spells) are used because no read page gives the day; excluded-spell dates (Hartlepools 1965-67, Brighton 1973-74, Leeds 1974) come from memory and are unverified.
openQuestions: No read source describes marking scheme (zonal vs man-to-man), pressing or transitions for either spell; Viv Anderson's 'If I kick my marker' line is about his own duel on the wing, not a team system.
Exact start day of Derby (May 1967) and end (October 1973; Sky says resigned October 1973), and Forest end (May 1993) come from partial dates; exact days not taken from memory.

Forest start 6 January 1975 appears in FourFourTwo only as 'January 1975' and in the EFL page, which returned no paragraphs; Viv Anderson's account places the first match as the FA Cup replay against Tottenham.
Shilton fee: FourFourTwo says £270,000; another source in search summaries says £250,000 or £350,000.
Whether Clough's own autobiographies (Clough, 1994; Walking on Water, 2002) can be cited primary was not verified: only attributed quotes found in secondary pages.

Excluded Hartlepools 1965-67 (Fourth Division, eighth in the last season, no titles, no tactical coverage found), Brighton 1973-74 (Third Division, no titles, short, Taylor-led) and Leeds 1974 (44 days, under 10 matches). Dates from memory not used; Leeds 44 days from FourFourTwo.
Peter Taylor was absent for the first months at Forest (rejoined after about a year, per McGovern; Planet Football says 1976); counted spell includes the Taylor-less period.
